title: Hala App
description: A smart bilingual directory connecting Qatar's businesses and communities through a mobile-first platform with Arabic and English support.

hero.headline: A smart bilingual directory connecting Qatar's businesses and communities.

paragraphs: Hala is a Qatar-based mobile application that bridges businesses and consumers through a smart, bilingual directory and premium advertising platform. Companies list their services and book premium placement spaces. Users discover local businesses by category — in both Arabic and English, seamlessly.

Qatar's diverse, multilingual population needs a single trusted platform to discover and engage with local businesses — in both Arabic and English. Most existing apps had poor RTL support or inconsistent visual hierarchy when switching languages. Both sides of the market were underserved.

process.heading: From dual-user research to bilingual, high-fidelity screens.
process.description: The language toggle was not a feature — it was the first UX decision. The moment a user picks their language, the entire app speaks their world.

phases.title: Discovery & Research
phases.description: Analyzed competitor apps in the MENA region and identified a critical gap: most apps either had poor RTL support or inconsistent visual hierarchy when switching languages. Mapped out both business-side and consumer-side user journeys to understand divergent needs within a single product.

phases.title: IA & Flows
phases.description: Structured two core flows — onboarding & registration (for businesses and users) and the discovery & engagement flow. Defined the plan selection screen (Platinum, Gold, Silver) as the key business conversion touchpoint, requiring focused hierarchy and pricing clarity.

phases.title: Visual Design
phases.description: Built the UI around a deep navy blue (#1A1A6E) and golden yellow (#F7B500) palette — evoking Qatar's authoritative, premium market feel. High contrast ensured readability across Arabic and English text at all sizes. Coral-red icons created clear, warm category signifiers.

phases.title: Bilingual UX
phases.description: Designed language selection as the very first interaction — giving users immediate agency before entering any flow. Every screen was built with RTL/LTR mirroring in mind. Text alignment, icon placement, and navigation direction all adapt to the selected language, creating a truly native experience in both directions.

phases.title: Prototyping & Handoff
phases.description: Delivered high-fidelity prototypes covering all user flows. Developer handoff included annotated Figma files with spacing, component states, and bilingual layout notes — ensuring the engineering team could implement both language directions without guesswork.

applications.heading: Eight screens. Every touchpoint in the user journey, considered.

apps.name: Splash & Language Selection
apps.insight: Bold navy canvas with the golden Hala logo. A bilingual toggle lets users choose English or Arabic before entering the app — the entire experience localizes from the first tap.

apps.name: Login Screen
apps.insight: Clean, minimal login on dark navy. A golden CTA button draws the eye immediately. Reset password and register links reduce friction for users who land here by mistake.

apps.name: Registration Screen
apps.insight: Business registration collects personal then professional identity in a single scrollable form — mirroring natural onboarding logic for a zero-friction sign-up.

apps.name: Home / Premium Space
apps.insight: Leads with a "Premium Space" banner showcasing partner brand logos — immediately communicating value to businesses. A "Book your Space" CTA drives the core business action. The category search grid follows for consumer discovery.

apps.name: Category Search
apps.insight: Six bold tiles (Medical, Food, Car, Electronic, Travel, Education) with coral-red circular icons. A search bar above serves both browse and intent-driven users in a single view.

apps.name: Plan Selection
apps.insight: Platinum expanded by default, pricing (QAR 29) and "Book Now" CTA prominently placed. A conversion-focused touchpoint designed with clear hierarchy, pricing transparency, and minimal cognitive load.

apps.name: Category Listing
apps.insight: "Premium" tags on select listings create a visual hierarchy rewarding businesses who invest in the platform — and signaling quality to users browsing the directory.

apps.name: Location / Map View
apps.insight: Embedded map with a "Drive" CTA — reducing the steps from discovery to navigation to a single tap. Business name displayed clearly above the action button.

outcome.quote: A bilingual B2B directory and premium space booking platform designed to connect Qatar's businesses and communities — with clarity, trust, and purpose.

deliverables.title: Authority
deliverables.description: Deep navy palette commands trust in a premium market — the right visual language for Qatar's B2B context.

deliverables.title: Warmth
deliverables.description: Coral-red category icons and golden accents create approachability — turning a directory into an experience people want to use.

deliverables.title: Clarity
deliverables.description: High contrast typography and consistent components across 20+ screens and two language directions — zero hierarchy confusion in any language.
